lines.text: We pigged out on pizza last night.

data.define: To eat a very large amount of food happily.

example.text: We pigged out on pizza last night.

misuse.text: Don't tell your host she made you 'pig out'.

data.l1_hook: Cả cái pizza biến mất rồi!
data.l1_ex: Tối qua tụi tui pigged out pizza luôn.

native.caption:
“pig out” nghĩa là gì?
“pig out” = Ăn quên trời đất.
Ví dụ: “We pigged out on pizza last night.” (Tối qua tụi tui pigged out pizza luôn.)
Học tiếng lóng tiếng Anh miễn phí trên Lexkite.
